lines.text: Nahum the Elkoshite has a vision against Nineveh, saying the LORD is jealous and avenging, slow to anger, and will punish the guilty.
The LORD dries up the sea and rivers, the mountains quake, and rocks are shattered before His burning anger.
The LORD is a stronghold for those who trust in Him, but with an overwhelming fire He will make an end of Nineveh.
The LORD says He will cut down the numerous allies and will break the yoke from the neck of Israel.
The LORD will prepare Nineveh's grave, and Judah is told to celebrate her feasts because the wicked will never again march through.
